subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Maria Montessori's educational method employs two types of classroom materials.
• The method uses sensory materials during the early learning phase.
• These sensory materials help children develop their perceptual abilities.
• The method later introduces academic materials as children advance.
• These academic materials help children apply their developed skills to formal subjects.
prompt: The student wants to contrast the purposes of the two types of materials in Montessori education. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Montessori's sensory materials help children develop their perceptual abilities, while the academic materials help them apply their developed skills to formal subjects.
choices.B: Maria Montessori's educational method, which uses sensory materials during early learning and academic materials as children advance, employs two types of classroom materials.
choices.C: Montessori's two types of materials, sensory and academic, each serve a specific purpose for children's development.
choices.D: Maria Montessori developed an educational method that employs both sensory materials and academic materials in the classroom.

explanation: Choice A is correct. It contrasts purposes: sensory materials help develop perceptual abilities, while academic materials help apply skills to formal subjects.
